scientific_integrity: The stated theorem is supported by an analytic proof and an executable exact-symbolic and finite-test checker. Computations support rather than replace the proof; no independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only the sixth moment and three consecutive, distinct quotient-frequency cosets.
The stabilized cyclic order-seven-and-above value is the classical analytic quadratic case; the new finite-torsion and lifted equality classification is the focus.
Priority remains subject to older exact small-degree finite-grid Nikolskii tables not exhaustively accessible.
title: Sharp sixth moments and phase localization for three consecutive Fourier cosets
